Definition: from G303 and G681; to enkindle:--kindle, light.
BiblicalUsage: The word means to kindle, to light: Jesus says He has come to send fire on the earth, and wishes it were already kindled — and James says the tongue is a little member that boasts great things, and behold how great a matter a little fire kindleth. The same word is the fire Jesus came to send and the fire a tongue can start.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for kindling carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the two fires — the fire Christ came to send on the earth, and the little fire of the tongue.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
